deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.description: Write and reason with DeepSeek models through the public Ace Data Cloud AI Dialogue conversation API. Choose the model explicitly and receive a conversation result.

claude.name: Claude
claude.brief: Claude writing, reasoning and token counting
claude.description: Write, analyze and revise content with Claude through chat or native Messages tools. Count tokens before sending a larger request.

maestro.name: Maestro
maestro.brief: Turn a brief into a narrated video
maestro.description: Produce an end-to-end video from a creative brief with visual style, narration and language controls. Retrieve the task to get the finished video.
scenarios: turn a campaign brief into a narrated video

turnstile.name: Turnstile
turnstile.description: Integrate Turnstile challenge processing into an authorized site-testing workflow using a site URL and site key.
scenarios: inspect task completion in a controlled environment.

image2text.name: Captcha_OCR
image2text.description: Recognize letters and numbers in verification images for authorized testing workflows.
scenarios: Check OCR on a self-created test image

kimi.name: Kimi
kimi.description: Use Kimi models to draft, reason about and summarize text in an agent or workflow.

hailuo.name: Hailuo
hailuo.brief: Hailuo text and image to video
hailuo.description: Create Hailuo clips from text or an image and follow the task through to its final video URL.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.description: Use OpenAI chat and Responses, generate or edit images, and create embeddings. Each tool exposes its current model and input options.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.brief: Gemini chat, content and video tools
gemini.description: Use Gemini chat and native content requests, or create a video and retrieve its completed result.

grok.name: Grok
grok.description: Ask Grok to write and reason, or turn a text or image brief into a video with task retrieval.

veo.name: Veo
veo.brief: Veo video creation and result retrieval
veo.description: Create videos from text or supported image references with Veo. Retrieve the submitted task and use the finished media URL in the next step.
scenarios: generate a clip from visual ingredients.

aichat.name: AI_Chat
aichat.description: Start and retrieve conversations using Ace Data Cloud's multi-model conversation APIs. Select a model explicitly and keep conversation IDs for follow-up turns.

serp.name: Google_Search
serp.brief: Google search with sources and filters
serp.description: Find web pages, images, news, maps and other supported search results with country, language, recency and pagination controls.

luma.name: Luma
luma.description: Generate a video from text or supported image references, extend a prior result, and retrieve the final video through the task tool.

identity.name: Identity_Verification
identity.description: Use identity, phone and bank-card verification tools in an explicitly authorized workflow. Inputs and results require private handling and an accurate privacy declaration.

seedance.name: Seedance
seedance.description: Create videos with Seedance from text and supported image, audio or video references. Select model-specific duration and output options, then retrieve the task.

recaptcha.name: reCAPTCHA
recaptcha.description: Process supported reCAPTCHA token or image-recognition requests in authorized integration tests.

hcaptcha.name: hCaptcha
hcaptcha.description: Process supported hCaptcha token or recognition requests and retrieve task results in authorized testing workflows.

qwen-image.name: Qwen_Image
qwen-image.description: Create images from text or edit supported reference images with Qwen Image, then retrieve the finished image URLs.

shorturl.name: Short_URL
shorturl.brief: Compact links for campaigns and sharing
shorturl.description: Turn a long public URL into a compact shareable link. Use the returned data.url in the next workflow step.
scenarios: create a compact link in a workflow.

webextrator.name: Web_Extractor
webextrator.brief: Render pages and extract structured content
webextrator.description: Render a public web page or extract its content with WebExtrator. Retrieve asynchronous tasks and inspect the actual output before using it.

producer.name: Producer
producer.brief: Songs, lyrics, stems and audio exports
producer.description: Generate music and lyrics, extend or transform supported tracks, and retrieve tasks or export formats with Producer.
scenarios: produce a variation of an authorized track.

nano-banana.name: Nano_Banana
nano-banana.brief: Nano Banana image creation and editing
nano-banana.description: Generate images from a prompt or edit image references with Nano Banana. Select a model, aspect ratio and resolution, then retrieve completed results.
scenarios: adapt a visual for social media.

wan.name: Wan
wan.brief: Wan text, image and reference video
wan.description: Create videos with Wan from text, images or supported reference video. Use the task tool to retrieve the finished result.
scenarios: create a scene from authorized references.

dreamina.name: Dreamina
dreamina.brief: Animate a portrait with an audio track
dreamina.description: Turn an authorized portrait and audio track into a talking-photo video with Dreamina, then retrieve the completed task.

suno.name: Suno
suno.brief: Suno songs, lyrics and music production
suno.description: Create songs and lyrics, extend or transform tracks, manage supported personas and studio projects, and retrieve music or export formats with Suno.
scenarios: assemble and export a multi-track project.

digitalhuman.name: Digital_Human
digitalhuman.brief: Talking avatars, voice and video tools
digitalhuman.description: Create a talking-avatar video from authorized visual and audio or text inputs. Manage supported voices and retrieve completed tasks.

happyhorse.name: HappyHorse
happyhorse.description: Generate videos from text or images, use supported reference videos, or edit a clip with HappyHorse. Retrieve final media through the task tool.

kling.name: Kling
kling.brief: Kling video, motion and commerce tools
kling.description: Create videos, talking photos, lip sync and motion-controlled clips with Kling. Use commerce tools for supported product workflows and retrieve final tasks.
scenarios: control movement from an authorized reference.

localization.name: Localization
localization.description: Translate localization content into a target locale while specifying the source format. Review the returned translation before release.

fish.name: Fish_Audio
fish.brief: Text to speech and authorized voice tools
fish.description: Turn text into speech, browse supported saved voices, or create a voice from authorized reference audio. Retrieve asynchronous speech tasks.
scenarios: use your own licensed voice reference.

minimax.name: MiniMax
minimax.brief: MiniMax video creation and task retrieval
minimax.description: Create MiniMax videos from supported content inputs, duration and resolution settings. Retrieve tasks to obtain the completed video.

glm.name: GLM
glm.description: Use GLM chat models for writing, analysis and reasoning with explicit model selection and non-streaming results.

seedream.name: Seedream
seedream.description: Generate images, edit references and use supported layer or transparency options with Seedream. Choose model-specific settings and retrieve completed tasks.

flux.name: FLUX
flux.brief: Flux image editing and video creation
flux.description: Generate and edit images with Flux or create Flux 3 videos using the supported request modes. Retrieve tasks to collect finished media.
scenarios: turn a scene into a video.
